name: Exsequia
positioning: Exsequia is the compliance-grade platform for planning, documenting, and executing final arrangements — so families act on decisions, not guesswork.

hero.h1: Every final arrangement, documented and ready.
hero.sub: Exsequia turns fragmented paperwork, prepaid contracts, and family instructions into a single verified record your executor can act on — without a scavenger hunt through filing cabinets.

features.title: Arrangement Vault
features.description: Store service preferences, prepaid plans, and provider contracts in one encrypted record — each field time-stamped and versioned for audit.

features.title: Executor Handoff
features.description: Grant a named executor scoped access that activates on verification, so instructions surface the moment they are needed — not weeks later.

features.title: Provider Directory
features.description: Compare licensed funeral homes, crematories, and celebrants with itemized pricing pulled from published general price lists.

features.title: Cost Ledger
features.description: Track deposits, prepaid balances, and estimated obligations against your plan, with variance alerts when quotes drift.

features.title: Notification Register
features.description: Maintain the who-to-tell list — beneficiaries, agencies, and institutions — with prewritten templates ready to dispatch.

features.title: Compliance Review
features.description: Automated checks against state disclosure and prepaid-funeral trust requirements flag gaps before they become disputes.

testimonials.quote: I settled my father's arrangements in an afternoon because everything he decided was already in Exsequia. No binders, no guessing which crematory he'd prepaid.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Halloran

testimonials.quote: We onboard every prearrangement client through Exsequia now. The versioned record ends the awkward calls where families dispute what was chosen.
testimonials.name: Desmond Ackroyd

testimonials.quote: As an estate planner, I finally have a system where the final-wishes documentation matches the will. Exsequia closed a gap that used to cost my clients weeks.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: Document your wishes and keep one verified record current.
Full planning, cost tracking, and compliant handoff for a household.
Coordinated administration for families, trusts, and advisors.

homepage.footerBlurb: Exsequia is a records and coordination platform. It does not provide funeral, legal, or financial services and is not a substitute for licensed counsel.
